how: A proposed Garrus image is taken up by members starting his chin and drawing his outline.
Recruitment recurs for starting, defending, holding partly built features, and finishing the work.
A helper receives a bare thank-you that asks for nothing back.

Participants report interior progress, active drawing, and the condition of the relocated work.
Coordinates, available-colour images, and explicit model confirmation help align individual placers.
Manual effort and chat organization leave machine placement unobserved without establishing its absence.
Upkeep combines cleaning, repairing trolling, staying awake under attack, and recruiting defenders for unfinished features.
A participant attributes a threat by relaying another room's takeover plans without identifying individual pixel changers.
Members negotiate overlap, recall cession, and bargain over routes and preservation within a threatened taskbar.
Builders stop or refuse to overwrite neighbours after direct requests, while another member challenges that restraint.
Help is offered and returned, with one helper explicitly naming earlier assistance as the reason for reciprocating.
A participant reports representing the room in a multi-faction congress alongside other diplomatic chats.

Contest talk includes disparaging battle language and a contrast between the room's restraint and another group's bulldozing.

The final-copy post elicits celebration, collective credit, and recollections of protective labour.
Participants mourn erasure, request screenshots before danger, recount the journey, and preserve a shared memory in the picture.
Calling the image a shared memory does not establish a successor canvas, organizational continuation, or reuse project.
April Fools fakes and glitch jokes are recognized and contested without making the canvas calls merely jokes.
Reported chat coordination neither tests cross-room prevalence nor establishes whether unseen deliberations created formal internal order.
Fandom language and an undated past disagreement do not establish that a pre-canvas tie selected the attack target.
The alliance appeal's reference to past disagreement does not establish a quarrel predating the canvas.
Fandom lore frames diplomacy, mobilisation, and the contested choice to spare neighbouring work.

Host boundaries combine duplicate and title-rule enforcement with off-topic removal and explicit fatigue over canvas traffic.

statement: Relaying plans between chat participants and placers outside the chat
how: Internal chat coordination requires a route back to placers outside it, whose participation exceeds chat membership and prompts a wish for a sticky.
The loss-first formulation must also admit preventive moves or stopping undertaken to spare neighbours before the builder's own work is erased.
Relocation returns participants to construction, as explicit rebuilding reports connect moving with a fresh build.
Calls and work reports support participation locally without proving that each call caused later pixel placement.
The opening combines starting and calling in one utterance rather than establishing a distinct ordered pair.
The poster explicitly turns success in establishing the logo into a request for more help defending it.
A defensive warning elicits an existing negotiated deal, supporting their connection without proving that this warning initiated negotiation.
Recalling cession answers a defence call, while a direct neighbour request supplies the stated reason for stopping.

A builder reports finished facial features and later congratulates the group on securing the image.

Treat a template as settling design only where alignment is demonstrated, since members also report corrections repeatedly undone by other placers.
Visible joining can add proposals or explain its motives, so bare acknowledgments cannot establish a general preferred format for accepting calls.

An invitation to discuss overlap receives an offer to finish the neighbour's picture before completing the outpost.
Retaliatory advocacy can arise inside building discussion, but its explicitly stated trigger is loss of completed work rather than recruitment alone.
A call to disregard the neighbour receives a direct refusal justified by that neighbour's polite request.
The reply to covering a neighbour invokes an earlier request to work around it rather than negotiating a new treaty.

Defence and participation in inter-room chats coexist, but the record does not establish that strain caused entry into the forum.
Separate reactions to canvas traffic from automatic application of pre-existing title rules, which require no demonstrated flood.
Negotiation supports an envoy's compliance caveat, but does not establish later conscious rejection of authority by uninformed placers.
